blocks.text:
name: 'Setup Flutter (persistent self-hosted SDK)'
description: >-
  Marker-pinned Flutter SDK kept under $HOME/actions-runner-yoloit across
  runs. On a persistent self-hosted runner the subosito/flutter-action
  cache is an anti-optimization (issue #354): setup untars a ~1GB archive
  every job and the POST step re-tars the whole SDK every run even when
  the version did not change — 14.5 of 19.7 minutes around a 4-minute
  iOS build. This action downloads the SDK exactly once per pinned
  version and reuses it subsecond afterwards. The SDK lives in
  per-version directories with an atomically-flipped `current` symlink
  (#357 review): both build-macos matrix arch legs run CONCURRENTLY on
  the one self-hosted runner, so every slot mutation is a single
  rename(2) and concurrent installs of the same pin converge instead of
  racing (sdk_slot.py documents the contract; test/
  setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart pins the decision scenarios and
  the regression guard).

inputs:
  flutter-version:
    description: 'Version spec — wildcard (3.47.x) or exact (3.47.4), same semantics as subosito/flutter-action'
    required: true

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Resolve pin and reuse-or-install the SDK
      id: sdk
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail

        SPEC='${{ inputs.flutter-version }}'
        SDK_ROOT="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/flutter-sdk"
        CURRENT="$SDK_ROOT/current"   # symlink -> $SDK_ROOT/<version>
        MARKER="$SDK_ROOT/.fah-version"
        SLOT="${{ github.action_path }}/sdk_slot.py"
        mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT"

        # Pre-#357 layouts kept the live SDK in a real `current`
        # directory — move it into its per-version slot once,
        # race-tolerantly (a concurrent leg that loses the migration
        # no-ops; os.rename never merges).
        python3 "$SLOT" migrate "$SDK_ROOT" "$MARKER"

        # Resolve the spec to a concrete stable version from the
        # official manifest (same resolution subosito/flutter-action
        # performs), then decide: SKIP (marker == wanted), REUSE
        # (manifest unreachable but the pinned SDK still satisfies the
        # spec) or INSTALL. The committed scenarios live in
        # test/setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart.
        DECISION="$(python3 "$SLOT" resolve "$SPEC" "$MARKER")"
        echo "$DECISION"
        VER="${DECISION#* }"
        DEST="$SDK_ROOT/$VER"

        # Self-heal before trusting a non-INSTALL verdict: a marker can
        # point at a version dir that a human or disk cleanup removed.
        # Without this the SKIP path would export a PATH entry with no
        # flutter binary under it and every later step would die at
        # `flutter --version` until someone deletes the marker by hand —
        # the brick the #357 review flagged on the old swap.
        if [[ "$DECISION" != INSTALL* && ! -d "$DEST" ]]; then
          echo "pinned $VER is missing from $SDK_ROOT — reinstalling"
          DECISION="INSTALL $VER"
        fi

        if [[ "$DECISION" == INSTALL* ]]; then
          if [[ -d "$DEST" ]]; then
            echo "Flutter $VER already installed by a concurrent leg — reusing it"
          else
            echo "Downloading Flutter $VER (spec: $SPEC) — one-time per pinned version..."
            STAGE="$(mktemp -d "$SDK_ROOT/.stage.XXXXXX")"
            # --max-time bounds EACH transfer, --retry-max-time bounds
            # the whole retry cycle: a wedged ~1GB download can never
            # hang the job until GitHub's ceiling kills it. (Same
            # pattern as the bounded asset downloads in build-macos.)
            if ! curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 \
                --max-time 600 --retry-max-time 900 \
                -o "$STAGE/flutter.zip" \
                "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/macos/flutter_macos_${VER}-stable.zip"; then
              echo "::error::Flutter SDK download for $VER failed after retries (bounded: --max-time 600 per attempt, --retry-max-time 900 total). The runner's network or storage.googleapis.com is unhealthy — check and re-run; partial state stayed inside $STAGE only, the pinned slot is untouched."
              exit 1
            fi
            unzip -q "$STAGE/flutter.zip" -d "$STAGE"
            # Atomic slot-in: rename(2) either lands the complete tree
            # or refuses because a concurrent leg already installed the
            # identical version — the loser discards its duplicate
            # (both legs fetch the same archive, so the bytes match).
            python3 "$SLOT" install "$STAGE/flutter" "$DEST"
            rm -rf "$STAGE"
          fi
        elif [[ "$DECISION" == REUSE* ]]; then
          echo "::warning::Flutter manifest unreachable — reusing pinned SDK $VER (satisfies $SPEC)"
        else
          echo "Flutter $VER already pinned at $CURRENT — skipping the download (issue #354)"
        fi

        # Publish the slot with one atomic symlink swap — idempotent
        # under concurrency (both matrix legs flip to the same target).

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1275` → `main`
- **State**: open

- **Deletions**: -2

- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:51:12Z

## PR Description

## gh-1275 — Built-in skills must ship CONTENT, not just directory structure

### Root Cause
- 1.0.512's app-side skill delivery (#1151) seeded `.fah/skills/` from bundled Flutter assets; the packaging never packed the SKILL.md content (same asset-diet class as #1227/#1272), so apps shipped skill DIRECTORY STRUCTURE with no usable content and the agent had no built-in skills on iOS.
- The mechanism half is already fixed in tree (gh-1164): every `prompts/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` is compiled into pure-Dart `builtinSkillFiles` by `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` and served from `builtin://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` on every host — no asset-bundle/filesystem dependency, merged last into discovery, never gated by the skills-access consent (AC4 intact, covered by `test/skills/builtin_skills_test.dart`).
- The missing half was the never-again hook: no release-gating check asserted SKILL.md CONTENT (byte size), only structure/wiring presence.

### Fix
- `scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` (new): the gh-1275 AC3 gate — flags empty/whitespace/frontmatter-only SKILL.md copies (1024-byte floor), skill dirs without SKILL.md, and packaged-vs-source name/byte drift; exit 1 with named `::error::` verdicts.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, `pages.yml`: fail-fast `Assert built-in skills packaged (gh-1275 AC3)` step in the iOS, Android (AAB + APK flavors), macOS, and web build jobs, before any build minute is spent (gh-798 "Assert TestFlight version floor" pattern).
- `test/skills/builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` (new): the same checkers run on every PR (gh-798 selftest pattern — the gate cannot rot silently), including RED fixtures shaped exactly like the incident (dirs present, content missing).
- `AGENTS.md`: retired the stale "js-apps seeds into `.fah/skills/` on startup" line (gh-1164 removed the seeder).

### Test Coverage
- `builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` — 13 tests: incident-shaped fixtures fail the gate (empty SKILL.md, dir without SKILL.md, stubs below the floor, parity drift), the real compiled `builtinSkillFiles` passes byte-identical to sources. PASS.
- `dart run scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` — exit 0 on the tree; exit 1 with named verdicts on a hollow fixture tree. VERIFIED.
- `test/skills/` + `test/prompts/` — 120 tests PASS. Full core suite: no regressions.

### Notes
- AC1/AC2 (verify TestFlight/Play/macOS/web builds end-to-end) still need a human release carrying this gate — the packaging path is shared pure-Dart compiled-in data, so the gate failing in any workflow proves the artifact is hollow before it ships.
- The cleanup in `_seedBundledSkills` intentionally leaves empty leftover dirs on upgraded devices; they are invisible to discovery (`_scanSkillDirs` skips dirs without SKILL.md) and harmless.

- The mechanism half is already fixed in tree (gh-1164): every `prompts/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` is compiled into pure-Dart `builtinSkillFiles` by `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` and served from `builtin://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` on every host — no asset-bundle/filesystem dependency, merged last into discovery, never gated by the skills-access consent (AC4 intact, covered by `test/skills/builtin_skills_test.dart`).
- The missing half was the never-again hook: no release-gating check asserted SKILL.md CONTENT (byte size), only structure/wiring presence.

### Fix
- `scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` (new): the gh-1275 AC3 gate — flags empty/whitespace/frontmatter-only SKILL.md copies (1024-byte floor), skill dirs without SKILL.md, and packaged-vs-source name/byte drift; exit 1 with named `::error::` verdicts.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, `pages.yml`: fail-fast `Assert built-in skills packaged (gh-1275 AC3)` step in the iOS, Android (AAB + APK flavors), macOS, and web build jobs, before any build minute is spent (gh-798 "Assert TestFlight version floor" pattern).
- `test/skills/builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` (new): the same checkers run on every PR (gh-798 selftest pattern — the gate cannot rot silently), including RED fixtures shaped exactly like the incident (dirs present, content missing).
- `AGENTS.md`: retired the stale "js-apps seeds into `.fah/skills/` on startup" line (gh-1164 removed the seeder).

### Test Coverage
- `builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` — 13 tests: incident-shaped fixtures fail the gate (empty SKILL.md, dir without SKILL.md, stubs below the floor, parity drift), the real compiled `builtinSkillFiles` passes byte-identical to sources. PASS.
- `dart run scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` — exit 0 on the tree; exit 1 with named verdicts on a hollow fixture tree. VERIFIED.
- `test/skills/` + `test/prompts/` — 120 tests PASS. Full core suite: no regressions.

- AC1/AC2 (verify TestFlight/Play/macOS/web builds end-to-end) still need a human release carrying this gate — the packaging path is shared pure-Dart compiled-in data, so the gate failing in any workflow proves the artifact is hollow before it ship…

blocks.text:
name: 'Setup Flutter (persistent self-hosted SDK)'
description: >-
  Marker-pinned Flutter SDK kept under $HOME/actions-runner-yoloit across
  runs. On a persistent self-hosted runner the subosito/flutter-action
  cache is an anti-optimization (issue #354): setup untars a ~1GB archive
  every job and the POST step re-tars the whole SDK every run even when
  the version did not change — 14.5 of 19.7 minutes around a 4-minute
  iOS build. This action downloads the SDK exactly once per pinned
  version and reuses it subsecond afterwards. The SDK lives in
  per-version directories with an atomically-flipped `current` symlink
  (#357 review): both build-macos matrix arch legs run CONCURRENTLY on
  the one self-hosted runner, so every slot mutation is a single
  rename(2) and concurrent installs of the same pin converge instead of
  racing (sdk_slot.py documents the contract; test/
  setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart pins the decision scenarios and
  the regression guard).

inputs:
  flutter-version:
    description: 'Version spec — wildcard (3.47.x) or exact (3.47.4), same semantics as subosito/flutter-action'
    required: true

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Resolve pin and reuse-or-install the SDK
      id: sdk
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail

        SPEC='${{ inputs.flutter-version }}'
        SDK_ROOT="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/flutter-sdk"
        CURRENT="$SDK_ROOT/current"   # symlink -> $SDK_ROOT/<version>
        MARKER="$SDK_ROOT/.fah-version"
        SLOT="${{ github.action_path }}/sdk_slot.py"
        mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT"

        # Pre-#357 layouts kept the live SDK in a real `current`
        # directory — move it into its per-version slot once,
        # race-tolerantly (a concurrent leg that loses the migration
        # no-ops; os.rename never merges).
        python3 "$SLOT" migrate "$SDK_ROOT" "$MARKER"

        # Resolve the spec to a concrete stable version from the
        # official manifest (same resolution subosito/flutter-action
        # performs), then decide: SKIP (marker == wanted), REUSE
        # (manifest unreachable but the pinned SDK still satisfies the
        # spec) or INSTALL. The committed scenarios live in
        # test/setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart.
        DECISION="$(python3 "$SLOT" resolve "$SPEC" "$MARKER")"
        echo "$DECISION"
        VER="${DECISION#* }"
        DEST="$SDK_ROOT/$VER"

        # Self-heal before trusting a non-INSTALL verdict: a marker can
        # point at a version dir that a human or disk cleanup removed.
        # Without this the SKIP path would export a PATH entry with no
        # flutter binary under it and every later step would die at
        # `flutter --version` until someone deletes the marker by hand —
        # the brick the #357 review flagged on the old swap.
        if [[ "$DECISION" != INSTALL* && ! -d "$DEST" ]]; then
          echo "pinned $VER is missing from $SDK_ROOT — reinstalling"
          DECISION="INSTALL $VER"
        fi

        if [[ "$DECISION" == INSTALL* ]]; then
          if [[ -d "$DEST" ]]; then
            echo "Flutter $VER already installed by a concurrent leg — reusing it"
          else
            echo "Downloading Flutter $VER (spec: $SPEC) — one-time per pinned version..."
            STAGE="$(mktemp -d "$SDK_ROOT/.stage.XXXXXX")"
            # --max-time bounds EACH transfer, --retry-max-time bounds
            # the whole retry cycle: a wedged ~1GB download can never
            # hang the job until GitHub's ceiling kills it. (Same
            # pattern as the bounded asset downloads in build-macos.)
            if ! curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 \
                --max-time 600 --retry-max-time 900 \
                -o "$STAGE/flutter.zip" \
                "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/macos/flutter_macos_${VER}-stable.zip"; then
              echo "::error::Flutter SDK download for $VER failed after retries (bounded: --max-time 600 per attempt, --retry-max-time 900 total). The runner's network or storage.googleapis.com is unhealthy — check and re-run; partial state stayed inside $STAGE only, the pinned slot is untouched."
              exit 1
            fi
            unzip -q "$STAGE/flutter.zip" -d "$STAGE"
            # Atomic slot-in: rename(2) either lands the complete tree
            # or refuses because a concurrent leg already installed the
            # identical version — the loser discards its duplicate
            # (both legs fetch the same archive, so the bytes match).
            python3 "$SLOT" install "$STAGE/flutter" "$DEST"
            rm -rf "$STAGE"
          fi
        elif [[ "$DECISION" == REUSE* ]]; then
          echo "::warning::Flutter manifest unreachable — reusing pinned SDK $VER (satisfies $SPEC)"
        else
          echo "Flutter $VER already pinned at $CURRENT — skipping the download (issue #354)"
        fi

        # Publish the slot with one atomic symlink swap — idempotent
        # under concurrency (both matrix legs flip to the same target).
        # Readers resolve `current` per use, so they observe either the
        # previous complete tree or this one, never a missing or
        # half-populated SDK; superseded trees are only gc'd after a
        # 2-day drain window, so in-flight legs keep a complete tree.
        python3 "$SLOT" flip "$DEST" "$CURRENT"
        echo "$VER" > "$MARKER"
        echo "Pinned Flutter $VER at $CURRENT -> $DEST"
        python3 "$SLOT" gc "$SDK_ROOT" "$DEST" 2

        # No actions/cache anywhere in this path: there is no POST step,
        # so no re-tar of the ~1GB SDK after every job.
        echo "$CURRENT/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
        echo "FLUTTER_ROOT=$CURRENT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        "$CURRENT/bin/flutter" --version

- **Title**: gh-1275 [BUG] Built-in skills (#1151) not packaged into the apps: iOS ships EMPTY skill dirs (create-goal/fa-self-config/js-apps exist, SKILL.md missing) — verify macOS/Android too
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1275` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +436
- **Deletions**: -2
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:11:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:51:12Z

## PR Description

## gh-1275 — Built-in skills must ship CONTENT, not just directory structure

### Root Cause
- 1.0.512's app-side skill delivery (#1151) seeded `.fah/skills/` from bundled Flutter assets; the packaging never packed the SKILL.md content (same asset-diet class as #1227/#1272), so apps shipped skill DIRECTORY STRUCTURE with no usable content and the agent had no built-in skills on iOS.
- The mechanism half is already fixed in tree (gh-1164): every `prompts/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` is compiled into pure-Dart `builtinSkillFiles` by `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` and served from `builtin://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` on every host — no asset-bundle/filesystem dependency, merged last into discovery, never gated by the skills-access consent (AC4 intact, covered by `test/skills/builtin_skills_test.dart`).
- The missing half was the never-again hook: no release-gating check asserted SKILL.md CONTENT (byte size), only structure/wiring presence.

### Fix
- `scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` (new): the gh-1275 AC3 gate — flags empty/whitespace/frontmatter-only SKILL.md copies (1024-byte floor), skill dirs without SKILL.md, and packaged-vs-source name/byte drift; exit 1 with named `::error::` verdicts.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, `pages.yml`: fail-fast `Assert built-in skills packaged (gh-1275 AC3)` step in the iOS, Android (AAB + APK flavors), macOS, and web build jobs, before any build minute is spent (gh-798 "Assert TestFlight version floor" pattern).
- `test/skills/builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` (new): the same checkers run on every PR (gh-798 selftest pattern — the gate cannot rot silently), including RED fixtures shaped exactly like the incident (dirs present, content missing).
- `AGENTS.md`: retired the stale "js-apps seeds into `.fah/skills/` on startup" line (gh-1164 removed the seeder).

### Test Coverage
- `builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` — 13 tests: incident-shaped fixtures fail the gate (empty SKILL.md, dir without SKILL.md, stubs below the floor, parity drift), the real compiled `builtinSkillFiles` passes byte-identical to sources. PASS.
- `dart run scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` — exit 0 on the tree; exit 1 with named verdicts on a hollow fixture tree. VERIFIED.
- `test/skills/` + `test/prompts/` — 120 tests PASS. Full core suite: no regressions.

### Notes
- AC1/AC2 (verify TestFlight/Play/macOS/web builds end-to-end) still need a human release carrying this gate — the packaging path is shared pure-Dart compiled-in data, so the gate failing in any workflow proves the artifact is hollow before it ships.
- The cleanup in `_seedBundledSkills` intentionally leaves empty leftover dirs on upgraded devices; they are invisible to discovery (`_scanSkillDirs` skips dirs without SKILL.md) and harmless.

## Description

## gh-1275 — Built-in skills must ship CONTENT, not just directory structure

### Root Cause
- 1.0.512's app-side skill delivery (#1151) seeded `.fah/skills/` from bundled Flutter assets; the packaging never packed the SKILL.md content (same asset-diet class as #1227/#1272), so apps shipped skill DIRECTORY STRUCTURE with no usable content and the agent had no built-in skills on iOS.
- The mechanism half is already fixed in tree (gh-1164): every `prompts/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` is compiled into pure-Dart `builtinSkillFiles` by `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` and served from `builtin://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` on every host — no asset-bundle/filesystem dependency, merged last into discovery, never gated by the skills-access consent (AC4 intact, covered by `test/skills/builtin_skills_test.dart`).
- The missing half was the never-again hook: no release-gating check asserted SKILL.md CONTENT (byte size), only structure/wiring presence.

### Fix
- `scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` (new): the gh-1275 AC3 gate — flags empty/whitespace/frontmatter-only SKILL.md copies (1024-byte floor), skill dirs without SKILL.md, and packaged-vs-source name/byte drift; exit 1 with named `::error::` verdicts.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, `pages.yml`: fail-fast `Assert built-in skills packaged (gh-1275 AC3)` step in the iOS, Android (AAB + APK flavors), macOS, and web build jobs, before any build minute is spent (gh-798 "Assert TestFlight version floor" pattern).
- `test/skills/builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` (new): the same checkers run on every PR (gh-798 selftest pattern — the gate cannot rot silently), including RED fixtures shaped exactly like the incident (dirs present, content missing).
- `AGENTS.md`: retired the stale "js-apps seeds into `.fah/skills/` on startup" line (gh-1164 removed the seeder).

### Test Coverage
- `builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` — 13 tests: incident-shaped fixtures fail the gate (empty SKILL.md, dir without SKILL.md, stubs below the floor, parity drift), the real compiled `builtinSkillFiles` passes byte-identical to sources. PASS.
- `dart run scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` — exit 0 on the tree; exit 1 with named verdicts on a hollow fixture tree. VERIFIED.
- `test/skills/` + `test/prompts/` — 120 tests PASS. Full core suite: no regressions.

### Notes
- AC1/AC2 (verify TestFlight/Play/macOS/web builds end-to-end) still need a human release carrying this gate — the packaging path is shared pure-Dart compiled-in data, so the gate failing in any workflow proves the artifact is hollow before it ship…

blocks.text:
name: 'Setup Flutter (persistent self-hosted SDK)'
description: >-
  Marker-pinned Flutter SDK kept under $HOME/actions-runner-yoloit across
  runs. On a persistent self-hosted runner the subosito/flutter-action
  cache is an anti-optimization (issue #354): setup untars a ~1GB archive
  every job and the POST step re-tars the whole SDK every run even when
  the version did not change — 14.5 of 19.7 minutes around a 4-minute
  iOS build. This action downloads the SDK exactly once per pinned
  version and reuses it subsecond afterwards. The SDK lives in
  per-version directories with an atomically-flipped `current` symlink
  (#357 review): both build-macos matrix arch legs run CONCURRENTLY on
  the one self-hosted runner, so every slot mutation is a single
  rename(2) and concurrent installs of the same pin converge instead of
  racing (sdk_slot.py documents the contract; test/
  setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart pins the decision scenarios and
  the regression guard).

inputs:
  flutter-version:
    description: 'Version spec — wildcard (3.47.x) or exact (3.47.4), same semantics as subosito/flutter-action'
    required: true

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Resolve pin and reuse-or-install the SDK
      id: sdk
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail

        SPEC='${{ inputs.flutter-version }}'
        SDK_ROOT="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/flutter-sdk"
        CURRENT="$SDK_ROOT/current"   # symlink -> $SDK_ROOT/<version>
        MARKER="$SDK_ROOT/.fah-version"
        SLOT="${{ github.action_path }}/sdk_slot.py"
        mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT"

        # Pre-#357 layouts kept the live SDK in a real `current`
        # directory — move it into its per-version slot once,
        # race-tolerantly (a concurrent leg that loses the migration
        # no-ops; os.rename never merges).
        python3 "$SLOT" migrate "$SDK_ROOT" "$MARKER"

        # Resolve the spec to a concrete stable version from the
        # official manifest (same resolution subosito/flutter-action
        # performs), then decide: SKIP (marker == wanted), REUSE
        # (manifest unreachable but the pinned SDK still satisfies the
        # spec) or INSTALL. The committed scenarios live in
        # test/setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart.
        DECISION="$(python3 "$SLOT" resolve "$SPEC" "$MARKER")"
        echo "$DECISION"
        VER="${DECISION#* }"
        DEST="$SDK_ROOT/$VER"

        # Self-heal before trusting a non-INSTALL verdict: a marker can
        # point at a version dir that a human or disk cleanup removed.
        # Without this the SKIP path would export a PATH entry with no
        # flutter binary under it and every later step would die at
        # `flutter --version` until someone deletes the marker by hand —
        # the brick the #357 review flagged on the old swap.
        if [[ "$DECISION" != INSTALL* && ! -d "$DEST" ]]; then
          echo "pinned $VER is missing from $SDK_ROOT — reinstalling"
          DECISION="INSTALL $VER"
        fi

        if [[ "$DECISION" == INSTALL* ]]; then
          if [[ -d "$DEST" ]]; then
            echo "Flutter $VER already installed by a concurrent leg — reusing it"
          else
            echo "Downloading Flutter $VER (spec: $SPEC) — one-time per pinned version..."
            STAGE="$(mktemp -d "$SDK_ROOT/.stage.XXXXXX")"
            # --max-time bounds EACH transfer, --retry-max-time bounds
            # the whole retry cycle: a wedged ~1GB download can never
            # hang the job until GitHub's ceiling kills it. (Same
            # pattern as the bounded asset downloads in build-macos.)
            if ! curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 \
                --max-time 600 --retry-max-time 900 \
                -o "$STAGE/flutter.zip" \
                "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/macos/flutter_macos_${VER}-stable.zip"; then
              echo "::error::Flutter SDK download for $VER failed after retries (bounded: --max-time 600 per attempt, --retry-max-time 900 total). The runner's network or storage.googleapis.com is unhealthy — check and re-run; partial state stayed inside $STAGE only, the pinned slot is untouched."
              exit 1
            fi
            unzip -q "$STAGE/flutter.zip" -d "$STAGE"
            # Atomic slot-in: rename(2) either lands the complete tree
            # or refuses because a concurrent leg already installed the
            # identical version — the loser discards its duplicate
            # (both legs fetch the same archive, so the bytes match).
            python3 "$SLOT" install "$STAGE/flutter" "$DEST"
            rm -rf "$STAGE"
          fi
        elif [[ "$DECISION" == REUSE* ]]; then
          echo "::warning::Flutter manifest unreachable — reusing pinned SDK $VER (satisfies $SPEC)"
        else
          echo "Flutter $VER already pinned at $CURRENT — skipping the download (issue #354)"
        fi

        # Publish the slot with one atomic symlink swap — idempotent
        # under concurrency (both matrix legs flip to the same target).
        # Readers resolve `current` per use, so they observe either the
        # previous complete tree or this one, never a missing or
        # half-populated SDK; superseded trees are only gc'd after a
        # 2-day drain window, so in-flight legs keep a complete tree.
        python3 "$SLOT" flip "$DEST" "$CURRENT"
        echo "$VER" > "$MARKER"
        echo "Pinned Flutter $VER at $CURRENT -> $DEST"
        python3 "$SLOT" gc "$SDK_ROOT" "$DEST" 2

        # No actions/cache anywhere in this path: there is no POST step,
        # so no re-tar of the ~1GB SDK after every job.
        echo "$CURRENT/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
        echo "FLUTTER_ROOT=$CURRENT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        "$CURRENT/bin/flutter" --version

## PR Description

## gh-1275 — Built-in skills must ship CONTENT, not just directory structure

### Root Cause
- 1.0.512's app-side skill delivery (#1151) seeded `.fah/skills/` from bundled Flutter assets; the packaging never packed the SKILL.md content (same asset-diet class as #1227/#1272), so apps shipped skill DIRECTORY STRUCTURE with no usable content and the agent had no built-in skills on iOS.
- The mechanism half is already fixed in tree (gh-1164): every `prompts/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` is compiled into pure-Dart `builtinSkillFiles` by `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` and served from `builtin://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` on every host — no asset-bundle/filesystem dependency, merged last into discovery, never gated by the skills-access consent (AC4 intact, covered by `test/skills/builtin_skills_test.dart`).
- The missing half was the never-again hook: no release-gating check asserted SKILL.md CONTENT (byte size), only structure/wiring presence.

### Fix
- `scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` (new): the gh-1275 AC3 gate — flags empty/whitespace/frontmatter-only SKILL.md copies (1024-byte floor), skill dirs without SKILL.md, and packaged-vs-source name/byte drift; exit 1 with named `::error::` verdicts.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, `pages.yml`: fail-fast `Assert built-in skills packaged (gh-1275 AC3)` step in the iOS, Android (AAB + APK flavors), macOS, and web build jobs, before any build minute is spent (gh-798 "Assert TestFlight version floor" pattern).
- `test/skills/builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` (new): the same checkers run on every PR (gh-798 selftest pattern — the gate cannot rot silently), including RED fixtures shaped exactly like the incident (dirs present, content missing).
- `AGENTS.md`: retired the stale "js-apps seeds into `.fah/skills/` on startup" line (gh-1164 removed the seeder).

### Test Coverage
- `builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` — 13 tests: incident-shaped fixtures fail the gate (empty SKILL.md, dir without SKILL.md, stubs below the floor, parity drift), the real compiled `builtinSkillFiles` passes byte-identical to sources. PASS.
- `dart run scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` — exit 0 on the tree; exit 1 with named verdicts on a hollow fixture tree. VERIFIED.
- `test/skills/` + `test/prompts/` — 120 tests PASS. Full core suite: no regressions.

### Notes
- AC1/AC2 (verify TestFlight/Play/macOS/web builds end-to-end) still need a human release carrying this gate — the packaging path is shared pure-Dart compiled-in data, so the gate failing in any workflow proves the artifact is hollow before it ships.
- The cleanup in `_seedBundledSkills` intentionally leaves empty leftover dirs on upgraded devices; they are invisible to discovery (`_scanSkillDirs` skips dirs without SKILL.md) and harmless.

`builtinSkillSourceViolations` stats the file and then reads it fully — two filesystem reads, and the byte count can disagree with the content if the file changes between the calls (TOCTOU, admittedly theoretical for a CI gate):

```dart
final bytes = file.lengthSync();

```

Reading once keeps the verdict consistent with the bytes actually inspected:

```dart
final content = await file.readAsBytes();
final text = utf8.decode(content);
if (text.trim().isEmpty) { ... } else if (content.length < minBytes) { ... }
```

---

### Thread 2 — `scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-05):
💡 **SUGGESTION: replace the `uri.pathSegments.reversed.toList()[1]` basename idiom**

The name extraction relies on `Directory.uri` appending a trailing empty path segment so that `reversed[1]` is the directory name:

```dart
(d) => d.uri.pathSegments.reversed.toList()[1],
```

It works on POSIX and Windows today, but it is fragile and now duplicated in three places (`verify_builtin_skills.dart:88`, `verify_builtin_skills.dart:153`, and the byte-identical test at `builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart:173` — plus the same idiom in `scripts/gen_prompts.dart`). blocks.text:
name: 'Setup Flutter (persistent self-hosted SDK)'
description: >-
  Marker-pinned Flutter SDK kept under $HOME/actions-runner-yoloit across
  runs. On a persistent self-hosted runner the subosito/flutter-action
  cache is an anti-optimization (issue #354): setup untars a ~1GB archive
  every job and the POST step re-tars the whole SDK every run even when
  the version did not change — 14.5 of 19.7 minutes around a 4-minute
  iOS build. This action downloads the SDK exactly once per pinned
  version and reuses it subsecond afterwards. The SDK lives in
  per-version directories with an atomically-flipped `current` symlink
  (#357 review): both build-macos matrix arch legs run CONCURRENTLY on
  the one self-hosted runner, so every slot mutation is a single
  rename(2) and concurrent installs of the same pin converge instead of
  racing (sdk_slot.py documents the contract; test/
  setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart pins the decision scenarios and
  the regression guard).

inputs:
  flutter-version:
    description: 'Version spec — wildcard (3.47.x) or exact (3.47.4), same semantics as subosito/flutter-action'
    required: true

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Resolve pin and reuse-or-install the SDK
      id: sdk
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail

        SPEC='${{ inputs.flutter-version }}'
        SDK_ROOT="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/flutter-sdk"
        CURRENT="$SDK_ROOT/current"   # symlink -> $SDK_ROOT/<version>
        MARKER="$SDK_ROOT/.fah-version"
        SLOT="${{ github.action_path }}/sdk_slot.py"
        mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT"

        # Pre-#357 layouts kept the live SDK in a real `current`
        # directory — move it into its per-version slot once,
        # race-tolerantly (a concurrent leg that loses the migration
        # no-ops; os.rename never merges).
        python3 "$SLOT" migrate "$SDK_ROOT" "$MARKER"

        # Resolve the spec to a concrete stable version from the
        # official manifest (same resolution subosito/flutter-action
        # performs), then decide: SKIP (marker == wanted), REUSE
        # (manifest unreachable but the pinned SDK still satisfies the
        # spec) or INSTALL. The committed scenarios live in
        # test/setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart.
        DECISION="$(python3 "$SLOT" resolve "$SPEC" "$MARKER")"
        echo "$DECISION"
        VER="${DECISION#* }"
        DEST="$SDK_ROOT/$VER"

        # Self-heal before trusting a non-INSTALL verdict: a marker can
        # point at a version dir that a human or disk cleanup removed.
        # Without this the SKIP path would export a PATH entry with no
        # flutter binary under it and every later step would die at
        # `flutter --version` until someone deletes the marker by hand —
        # the brick the #357 review flagged on the old swap.
        if [[ "$DECISION" != INSTALL* && ! -d "$DEST" ]]; then
          echo "pinned $VER is missing from $SDK_ROOT — reinstalling"
          DECISION="INSTALL $VER"
        fi

        if [[ "$DECISION" == INSTALL* ]]; then
          if [[ -d "$DEST" ]]; then
            echo "Flutter $VER already installed by a concurrent leg — reusing it"
          else
            echo "Downloading Flutter $VER (spec: $SPEC) — one-time per pinned version..."
            STAGE="$(mktemp -d "$SDK_ROOT/.stage.XXXXXX")"
            # --max-time bounds EACH transfer, --retry-max-time bounds
            # the whole retry cycle: a wedged ~1GB download can never
            # hang the job until GitHub's ceiling kills it. (Same
            # pattern as the bounded asset downloads in build-macos.)
            if ! curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 \
                --max-time 600 --retry-max-time 900 \
                -o "$STAGE/flutter.zip" \
                "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/macos/flutter_macos_${VER}-stable.zip"; then
              echo "::error::Flutter SDK download for $VER failed after retries (bounded: --max-time 600 per attempt, --retry-max-time 900 total). The runner's network or storage.googleapis.com is unhealthy — check and re-run; partial state stayed inside $STAGE only, the pinned slot is untouched."
              exit 1
            fi
            unzip -q "$STAGE/flutter.zip" -d "$STAGE"
            # Atomic slot-in: rename(2) either lands the complete tree
            # or refuses because a concurrent leg already installed the
            # identical version — the loser discards its duplicate
            # (both legs fetch the same archive, so the bytes match).
            python3 "$SLOT" install "$STAGE/flutter" "$DEST"
            rm -rf "$STAGE"
          fi
        elif [[ "$DECISION" == REUSE* ]]; then
          echo "::warning::Flutter manifest unreachable — reusing pinned SDK $VER (satisfies $SPEC)"
        else
          echo "Flutter $VER already pinned at $CURRENT — skipping the download (issue #354)"
        fi

        # Publish the slot with one atomic symlink swap — idempotent
        # under concurrency (both matrix legs flip to the same target).
        # Readers resolve `current` per use, so they observe either the
        # previous complete tree or this one, never a missing or
        # half-populated SDK; superseded trees are only gc'd after a
        # 2-day drain window, so in-flight legs keep a complete tree.
        python3 "$SLOT" flip "$DEST" "$CURRENT"
        echo "$VER" > "$MARKER"
        echo "Pinned Flutter $VER at $CURRENT -> $DEST"
        python3 "$SLOT" gc "$SDK_ROOT" "$DEST" 2

        # No actions/cache anywhere in this path: there is no POST step,
        # so no re-tar of the ~1GB SDK after every job.
        echo "$CURRENT/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
        echo "FLUTTER_ROOT=$CURRENT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        "$CURRENT/bin/flutter" --version

- **Author**: ai-teammate

- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:51:12Z

## PR Description

## gh-1275 — Built-in skills must ship CONTENT, not just directory structure

### Root Cause
- 1.0.512's app-side skill delivery (#1151) seeded `.fah/skills/` from bundled Flutter assets; the packaging never packed the SKILL.md content (same asset-diet class as #1227/#1272), so apps shipped skill DIRECTORY STRUCTURE with no usable content and the agent had no built-in skills on iOS.
- The mechanism half is already fixed in tree (gh-1164): every `prompts/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` is compiled into pure-Dart `builtinSkillFiles` by `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` and served from `builtin://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` on every host — no asset-bundle/filesystem dependency, merged last into discovery, never gated by the skills-access consent (AC4 intact, covered by `test/skills/builtin_skills_test.dart`).
- The missing half was the never-again hook: no release-gating check asserted SKILL.md CONTENT (byte size), only structure/wiring presence.

### Fix
- `scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` (new): the gh-1275 AC3 gate — flags empty/whitespace/frontmatter-only SKILL.md copies (1024-byte floor), skill dirs without SKILL.md, and packaged-vs-source name/byte drift; exit 1 with named `::error::` verdicts.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, `pages.yml`: fail-fast `Assert built-in skills packaged (gh-1275 AC3)` step in the iOS, Android (AAB + APK flavors), macOS, and web build jobs, before any build minute is spent (gh-798 "Assert TestFlight version floor" pattern).
- `test/skills/builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` (new): the same checkers run on every PR (gh-798 selftest pattern — the gate cannot rot silently), including RED fixtures shaped exactly like the incident (dirs present, content missing).
- `AGENTS.md`: retired the stale "js-apps seeds into `.fah/skills/` on startup" line (gh-1164 removed the seeder).

### Test Coverage
- `builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` — 13 tests: incident-shaped fixtures fail the gate (empty SKILL.md, dir without SKILL.md, stubs below the floor, parity drift), the real compiled `builtinSkillFiles` passes byte-identical to sources. PASS.
- `dart run scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` — exit 0 on the tree; exit 1 with named verdicts on a hollow fixture tree. VERIFIED.
- `test/skills/` + `test/prompts/` — 120 tests PASS. Full core suite: no regressions.

### Notes
- AC1/AC2 (verify TestFlight/Play/macOS/web builds end-to-end) still need a human release carrying this gate — the packaging path is shared pure-Dart compiled-in data, so the gate failing in any workflow proves the artifact is hollow before it ships.
- The cleanup in `_seedBundledSkills` intentionally leaves empty leftover dirs on upgraded devices; they are invisible to discovery (`_scanSkillDirs` skips dirs without SKILL.md) and harmless.

## Description

## gh-1275 — Built-in skills must ship CONTENT, not just directory structure

### Root Cause
- 1.0.512's app-side skill delivery (#1151) seeded `.fah/skills/` from bundled Flutter assets; the packaging never packed the SKILL.md content (same asset-diet class as #1227/#1272), so apps shipped skill DIRECTORY STRUCTURE with no usable content and the agent had no built-in skills on iOS.
- The mechanism half is already fixed in tree (gh-1164): every `prompts/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` is compiled into pure-Dart `builtinSkillFiles` by `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` and served from `builtin://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` on every host — no asset-bundle/filesystem dependency, merged last into discovery, never gated by the skills-access consent (AC4 intact, covered by `test/skills/builtin_skills_test.dart`).
- The missing half was the never-again hook: no release-gating check asserted SKILL.md CONTENT (byte size), only structure/wiring presence.

### Fix
- `scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` (new): the gh-1275 AC3 gate — flags empty/whitespace/frontmatter-only SKILL.md copies (1024-byte floor), skill dirs without SKILL.md, and packaged-vs-source name/byte drift; exit 1 with named `::error::` verdicts.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, `pages.yml`: fail-fast `Assert built-in skills packaged (gh-1275 AC3)` step in the iOS, Android (AAB + APK flavors), macOS, and web build jobs, before any build minute is spent (gh-798 "Assert TestFlight version floor" pattern).
- `test/skills/builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` (new): the same checkers run on every PR (gh-798 selftest pattern — the gate cannot rot silently), including RED fixtures shaped exactly like the incident (dirs present, content missing).
- `AGENTS.md`: retired the stale "js-apps seeds into `.fah/skills/` on startup" line (gh-1164 removed the seeder).

### Test Coverage
- `builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` — 13 tests: incident-shaped fixtures fail the gate (empty SKILL.md, dir without SKILL.md, stubs below the floor, parity drift), the real compiled `builtinSkillFiles` passes byte-identical to sources. PASS.
- `dart run scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` — exit 0 on the tree; exit 1 with named verdicts on a hollow fixture tree. VERIFIED.
- `test/skills/` + `test/prompts/` — 120 tests PASS. Full core suite: no regressions.

### Notes
- AC1/AC2 (verify TestFlight/Play/macOS/web builds end-to-end) still need a human release carrying this gate — the packaging path is shared pure-Dart compiled-in data, so the gate failing in any workflow proves the artifact is hollow before it ship…

blocks.text:
name: 'Setup Flutter (persistent self-hosted SDK)'
description: >-
  Marker-pinned Flutter SDK kept under $HOME/actions-runner-yoloit across
  runs. On a persistent self-hosted runner the subosito/flutter-action
  cache is an anti-optimization (issue #354): setup untars a ~1GB archive
  every job and the POST step re-tars the whole SDK every run even when
  the version did not change — 14.5 of 19.7 minutes around a 4-minute
  iOS build. This action downloads the SDK exactly once per pinned
  version and reuses it subsecond afterwards. The SDK lives in
  per-version directories with an atomically-flipped `current` symlink
  (#357 review): both build-macos matrix arch legs run CONCURRENTLY on
  the one self-hosted runner, so every slot mutation is a single
  rename(2) and concurrent installs of the same pin converge instead of
  racing (sdk_slot.py documents the contract; test/
  setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart pins the decision scenarios and
  the regression guard).

inputs:
  flutter-version:
    description: 'Version spec — wildcard (3.47.x) or exact (3.47.4), same semantics as subosito/flutter-action'
    required: true

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Resolve pin and reuse-or-install the SDK
      id: sdk
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail

        SPEC='${{ inputs.flutter-version }}'
        SDK_ROOT="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/flutter-sdk"
        CURRENT="$SDK_ROOT/current"   # symlink -> $SDK_ROOT/<version>
        MARKER="$SDK_ROOT/.fah-version"
        SLOT="${{ github.action_path }}/sdk_slot.py"
        mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT"

        # Pre-#357 layouts kept the live SDK in a real `current`
        # directory — move it into its per-version slot once,
        # race-tolerantly (a concurrent leg that loses the migration
        # no-ops; os.rename never merges).
        python3 "$SLOT" migrate "$SDK_ROOT" "$MARKER"

        # Resolve the spec to a concrete stable version from the
        # official manifest (same resolution subosito/flutter-action
        # performs), then decide: SKIP (marker == wanted), REUSE
        # (manifest unreachable but the pinned SDK still satisfies the
        # spec) or INSTALL. The committed scenarios live in
        # test/setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart.
        DECISION="$(python3 "$SLOT" resolve "$SPEC" "$MARKER")"
        echo "$DECISION"
        VER="${DECISION#* }"
        DEST="$SDK_ROOT/$VER"

        # Self-heal before trusting a non-INSTALL verdict: a marker can
        # point at a version dir that a human or disk cleanup removed.
        # Without this the SKIP path would export a PATH entry with no
        # flutter binary under it and every later step would die at
        # `flutter --version` until someone deletes the marker by hand —
        # the brick the #357 review flagged on the old swap.
        if [[ "$DECISION" != INSTALL* && ! -d "$DEST" ]]; then
          echo "pinned $VER is missing from $SDK_ROOT — reinstalling"
          DECISION="INSTALL $VER"
        fi

        if [[ "$DECISION" == INSTALL* ]]; then
          if [[ -d "$DEST" ]]; then
            echo "Flutter $VER already installed by a concurrent leg — reusing it"
          else
            echo "Downloading Flutter $VER (spec: $SPEC) — one-time per pinned version..."
            STAGE="$(mktemp -d "$SDK_ROOT/.stage.XXXXXX")"
            # --max-time bounds EACH transfer, --retry-max-time bounds
            # the whole retry cycle: a wedged ~1GB download can never
            # hang the job until GitHub's ceiling kills it. (Same
            # pattern as the bounded asset downloads in build-macos.)
            if ! curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 \
                --max-time 600 --retry-max-time 900 \
                -o "$STAGE/flutter.zip" \
                "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/macos/flutter_macos_${VER}-stable.zip"; then
              echo "::error::Flutter SDK download for $VER failed after retries (bounded: --max-time 600 per attempt, --retry-max-time 900 total). The runner's network or storage.googleapis.com is unhealthy — check and re-run; partial state stayed inside $STAGE only, the pinned slot is untouched."
              exit 1
            fi
            unzip -q "$STAGE/flutter.zip" -d "$STAGE"
            # Atomic slot-in: rename(2) either lands the complete tree
            # or refuses because a concurrent leg already installed the
            # identical version — the loser discards its duplicate
            # (both legs fetch the same archive, so the bytes match).
            python3 "$SLOT" install "$STAGE/flutter" "$DEST"
            rm -rf "$STAGE"
          fi
        elif [[ "$DECISION" == REUSE* ]]; then
          echo "::warning::Flutter manifest unreachable — reusing pinned SDK $VER (satisfies $SPEC)"
        else
          echo "Flutter $VER already pinned at $CURRENT — skipping the download (issue #354)"
        fi

        # Publish the slot with one atomic symlink swap — idempotent
        # under concurrency (both matrix legs flip to the same target).
        # Readers resolve `current` per use, so they observe either the
        # previous complete tree or this one, never a missing or
        # half-populated SDK; superseded trees are only gc'd after a
        # 2-day drain window, so in-flight legs keep a complete tree.
        python3 "$SLOT" flip "$DEST" "$CURRENT"
        echo "$VER" > "$MARKER"
        echo "Pinned Flutter $VER at $CURRENT -> $DEST"
        python3 "$SLOT" gc "$SDK_ROOT" "$DEST" 2

        # No actions/cache anywhere in this path: there is no POST step,
        # so no re-tar of the ~1GB SDK after every job.
        echo "$CURRENT/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
        echo "FLUTTER_ROOT=$CURRENT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        "$CURRENT/bin/flutter" --version

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1275` → `main`
- **State**: open

- **Deletions**: -2
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:11:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:51:12Z

## PR Description

## gh-1275 — Built-in skills must ship CONTENT, not just directory structure

### Root Cause
- 1.0.512's app-side skill delivery (#1151) seeded `.fah/skills/` from bundled Flutter assets; the packaging never packed the SKILL.md content (same asset-diet class as #1227/#1272), so apps shipped skill DIRECTORY STRUCTURE with no usable content and the agent had no built-in skills on iOS.
- The mechanism half is already fixed in tree (gh-1164): every `prompts/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` is compiled into pure-Dart `builtinSkillFiles` by `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` and served from `builtin://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` on every host — no asset-bundle/filesystem dependency, merged last into discovery, never gated by the skills-access consent (AC4 intact, covered by `test/skills/builtin_skills_test.dart`).
- The missing half was the never-again hook: no release-gating check asserted SKILL.md CONTENT (byte size), only structure/wiring presence.

### Fix
- `scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` (new): the gh-1275 AC3 gate — flags empty/whitespace/frontmatter-only SKILL.md copies (1024-byte floor), skill dirs without SKILL.md, and packaged-vs-source name/byte drift; exit 1 with named `::error::` verdicts.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, `pages.yml`: fail-fast `Assert built-in skills packaged (gh-1275 AC3)` step in the iOS, Android (AAB + APK flavors), macOS, and web build jobs, before any build minute is spent (gh-798 "Assert TestFlight version floor" pattern).
- `test/skills/builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` (new): the same checkers run on every PR (gh-798 selftest pattern — the gate cannot rot silently), including RED fixtures shaped exactly like the incident (dirs present, content missing).
- `AGENTS.md`: retired the stale "js-apps seeds into `.fah/skills/` on startup" line (gh-1164 removed the seeder).

### Test Coverage
- `builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` — 13 tests: incident-shaped fixtures fail the gate (empty SKILL.md, dir without SKILL.md, stubs below the floor, parity drift), the real compiled `builtinSkillFiles` passes byte-identical to sources. PASS.
- `dart run scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` — exit 0 on the tree; exit 1 with named verdicts on a hollow fixture tree. VERIFIED.
- `test/skills/` + `test/prompts/` — 120 tests PASS. Full core suite: no regressions.

### Notes
- AC1/AC2 (verify TestFlight/Play/macOS/web builds end-to-end) still need a human release carrying this gate — the packaging path is shared pure-Dart compiled-in data, so the gate failing in any workflow proves the artifact is hollow before it ships.
- The cleanup in `_seedBundledSkills` intentionally leaves empty leftover dirs on upgraded devices; they are invisible to discovery (`_scanSkillDirs` skips dirs without SKILL.md) and harmless.

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1277._

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-05):
💡 **SUGGESTION: read the file once instead of `lengthSync()` + `readAsString()`**

`builtinSkillSourceViolations` stats the file and then reads it fully — two filesystem reads, and the byte count can disagree with the content if the file changes between the calls (TOCTOU, admittedly theoretical for a CI gate):

```dart
final bytes = file.lengthSync();
if (bytes == 0 || (await file.readAsString()).trim().isEmpty) {
```

Reading once keeps the verdict consistent with the bytes actually inspected:

```dart
final content = await file.readAsBytes();
final text = utf8.decode(content);
if (text.trim().isEmpty) { ... } else if (content.length < minBytes) { ... }
```

---

### Thread 2 — `scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-05):
💡 **SUGGESTION: replace the `uri.pathSegments.reversed.toList()[1]` basename idiom**

The name extraction relies on `Directory.uri` appending a trailing empty path segment so that `reversed[1]` is the directory name:

```dart
(d) => d.uri.pathSegments.reversed.toList()[1],
```

It works on POSIX and Windows today, but it is fragile and now duplicated in three places (`verify_builtin_skills.dart:88`, `verify_builtin_skills.dart:153`, and the byte-identical test at `builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart:173` — plus the same idiom in `scripts/gen_prompts.dart`). A `basename`-style helper (e.g. `p.basename(d.path)` from `package:path`, already a transitive dep) would state the intent directly and give the four call sites one definition to stay consistent with `gen_prompts.dart`.

---

### Thread 3 — `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-05):
💡 **SUGGESTION: extract the duplicated gate step into a composite action**

The same five-line step (comment block + `dart pub get` + `dart run scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart`) is now copied into five jobs across `build-mobile.yml` (×3), `build-macos.yml`, and `pages.yml`. This mirrors the existing gh-798 pattern, so it is consistent with the codebase — but any future tweak to the gate invocation (extra arg, different reporter format, caching of `pub get`) has to be edited in five places and can silently drift. A `.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills/action.yml` composite action would keep the invocation single-sourced; the gh-798 "Assert TestFlight version floor" step has the same shape and could migrate with it.

# pr-1277: gh-1275 [BUG] Built-in skills (#1151) not packaged into the apps: iOS ships EMPTY skill dirs (create-goal/fa-self-config/js-apps exist, SKILL.md missing) — verify macOS/Android too

## Description

## gh-1275 — Built-in skills must ship CONTENT, not just directory structure

### Root Cause
- 1.0.512's app-side skill delivery (#1151) seeded `.fah/skills/` from bundled Flutter assets; the packaging never packed the SKILL.md content (same asset-diet class as #1227/#1272), so apps shipped skill DIRECTORY STRUCTURE with no usable content and the agent had no built-in skills on iOS.
- The mechanism half is already fixed in tree (gh-1164): every `prompts/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` is compiled into pure-Dart `builtinSkillFiles` by `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` and served from `builtin://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` on every host — no asset-bundle/filesystem dependency, merged last into discovery, never gated by the skills-access consent (AC4 intact, covered by `test/skills/builtin_skills_test.dart`).
- The missing half was the never-again hook: no release-gating check asserted SKILL.md CONTENT (byte size), only structure/wiring presence.

### Fix
- `scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` (new): the gh-1275 AC3 gate — flags empty/whitespace/frontmatter-only SKILL.md copies (1024-byte floor), skill dirs without SKILL.md, and packaged-vs-source name/byte drift; exit 1 with named `::error::` verdicts.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, `pages.yml`: fail-fast `Assert built-in skills packaged (gh-1275 AC3)` step in the iOS, Android (AAB + APK flavors), macOS, and web build jobs, before any build minute is spent (gh-798 "Assert TestFlight version floor" pattern).
- `test/skills/builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` (new): the same checkers run on every PR (gh-798 selftest pattern — the gate cannot rot silently), including RED fixtures shaped exactly like the incident (dirs present, content missing).
- `AGENTS.md`: retired the stale "js-apps seeds into `.fah/skills/` on startup" line (gh-1164 removed the seeder).

### Test Coverage
- `builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` — 13 tests: incident-shaped fixtures fail the gate (empty SKILL.md, dir without SKILL.md, stubs below the floor, parity drift), the real compiled `builtinSkillFiles` passes byte-identical to sources. PASS.
- `dart run scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` — exit 0 on the tree; exit 1 with named verdicts on a hollow fixture tree. VERIFIED.
- `test/skills/` + `test/prompts/` — 120 tests PASS. Full core suite: no regressions.

### Notes
- AC1/AC2 (verify TestFlight/Play/macOS/web builds end-to-end) still need a human release carrying this gate — the packaging path is shared pure-Dart compiled-in data, so the gate failing in any workflow proves the artifact is hollow before it ship…
Now look at the diff and the actual files in the tree. Note: the tree may already contain the PR changes (working dir). Let me check git status and the diff.

blocks.text:
name: 'Setup Flutter (persistent self-hosted SDK)'
description: >-
  Marker-pinned Flutter SDK kept under $HOME/actions-runner-yoloit across
  runs. On a persistent self-hosted runner the subosito/flutter-action
  cache is an anti-optimization (issue #354): setup untars a ~1GB archive
  every job and the POST step re-tars the whole SDK every run even when
  the version did not change — 14.5 of 19.7 minutes around a 4-minute
  iOS build. This action downloads the SDK exactly once per pinned
  version and reuses it subsecond afterwards. The SDK lives in
  per-version directories with an atomically-flipped `current` symlink
  (#357 review): both build-macos matrix arch legs run CONCURRENTLY on
  the one self-hosted runner, so every slot mutation is a single
  rename(2) and concurrent installs of the same pin converge instead of
  racing (sdk_slot.py documents the contract; test/
  setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart pins the decision scenarios and
  the regression guard).

inputs:
  flutter-version:
    description: 'Version spec — wildcard (3.47.x) or exact (3.47.4), same semantics as subosito/flutter-action'
    required: true

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Resolve pin and reuse-or-install the SDK
      id: sdk
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail

        SPEC='${{ inputs.flutter-version }}'
        SDK_ROOT="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/flutter-sdk"
        CURRENT="$SDK_ROOT/current"   # symlink -> $SDK_ROOT/<version>
        MARKER="$SDK_ROOT/.fah-version"
        SLOT="${{ github.action_path }}/sdk_slot.py"
        mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT"

        # Pre-#357 layouts kept the live SDK in a real `current`
        # directory — move it into its per-version slot once,
        # race-tolerantly (a concurrent leg that loses the migration
        # no-ops; os.rename never merges).
        python3 "$SLOT" migrate "$SDK_ROOT" "$MARKER"

        # Resolve the spec to a concrete stable version from the
        # official manifest (same resolution subosito/flutter-action
        # performs), then decide: SKIP (marker == wanted), REUSE
        # (manifest unreachable but the pinned SDK still satisfies the
        # spec) or INSTALL. The committed scenarios live in
        # test/setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart.
        DECISION="$(python3 "$SLOT" resolve "$SPEC" "$MARKER")"
        echo "$DECISION"
        VER="${DECISION#* }"
        DEST="$SDK_ROOT/$VER"

        # Self-heal before trusting a non-INSTALL verdict: a marker can
        # point at a version dir that a human or disk cleanup removed.
        # Without this the SKIP path would export a PATH entry with no
        # flutter binary under it and every later step would die at
        # `flutter --version` until someone deletes the marker by hand —
        # the brick the #357 review flagged on the old swap.
        if [[ "$DECISION" != INSTALL* && ! -d "$DEST" ]]; then
          echo "pinned $VER is missing from $SDK_ROOT — reinstalling"
          DECISION="INSTALL $VER"
        fi

        if [[ "$DECISION" == INSTALL* ]]; then
          if [[ -d "$DEST" ]]; then
            echo "Flutter $VER already installed by a concurrent leg — reusing it"
          else
            echo "Downloading Flutter $VER (spec: $SPEC) — one-time per pinned version..."
            STAGE="$(mktemp -d "$SDK_ROOT/.stage.XXXXXX")"
            # --max-time bounds EACH transfer, --retry-max-time bounds
            # the whole retry cycle: a wedged ~1GB download can never
            # hang the job until GitHub's ceiling kills it. (Same
            # pattern as the bounded asset downloads in build-macos.)
            if ! curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 \
                --max-time 600 --retry-max-time 900 \
                -o "$STAGE/flutter.zip" \
                "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/macos/flutter_macos_${VER}-stable.zip"; then
              echo "::error::Flutter SDK download for $VER failed after retries (bounded: --max-time 600 per attempt, --retry-max-time 900 total). The runner's network or storage.googleapis.com is unhealthy — check and re-run; partial state stayed inside $STAGE only, the pinned slot is untouched."
              exit 1
            fi
            unzip -q "$STAGE/flutter.zip" -d "$STAGE"
            # Atomic slot-in: rename(2) either lands the complete tree
            # or refuses because a concurrent leg already installed the
            # identical version — the loser discards its duplicate
            # (both legs fetch the same archive, so the bytes match).
            python3 "$SLOT" install "$STAGE/flutter" "$DEST"
            rm -rf "$STAGE"
          fi
        elif [[ "$DECISION" == REUSE* ]]; then
          echo "::warning::Flutter manifest unreachable — reusing pinned SDK $VER (satisfies $SPEC)"
        else
          echo "Flutter $VER already pinned at $CURRENT — skipping the download (issue #354)"
        fi

        # Publish the slot with one atomic symlink swap — idempotent
        # under concurrency (both matrix legs flip to the same target).
        # Readers resolve `current` per use, so they observe either the
        # previous complete tree or this one, never a missing or
        # half-populated SDK; superseded trees are only gc'd after a
        # 2-day drain window, so in-flight legs keep a complete tree.
        python3 "$SLOT" flip "$DEST" "$CURRENT"
        echo "$VER" > "$MARKER"
        echo "Pinned Flutter $VER at $CURRENT -> $DEST"
        python3 "$SLOT" gc "$SDK_ROOT" "$DEST" 2

        # No actions/cache anywhere in this path: there is no POST step,
        # so no re-tar of the ~1GB SDK after every job.
        echo "$CURRENT/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
        echo "FLUTTER_ROOT=$CURRENT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        "$CURRENT/bin/flutter" --version

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1277
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1277
- **Title**: gh-1275 [BUG] Built-in skills (#1151) not packaged into the apps: iOS ships EMPTY skill dirs (create-goal/fa-self-config/js-apps exist, SKILL.md missing) — verify macOS/Android too
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1275` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +436
- **Deletions**: -2
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:11:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:51:12Z

## PR Description

## gh-1275 — Built-in skills must ship CONTENT, not just directory structure

### Root Cause
- 1.0.512's app-side skill delivery (#1151) seeded `.fah/skills/` from bundled Flutter assets; the packaging never packed the SKILL.md content (same asset-diet class as #1227/#1272), so apps shipped skill DIRECTORY STRUCTURE with no usable content and the agent had no built-in skills on iOS.
- The mechanism half is already fixed in tree (gh-1164): every `prompts/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` is compiled into pure-Dart `builtinSkillFiles` by `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` and served from `builtin://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` on every host — no asset-bundle/filesystem dependency, merged last into discovery, never gated by the skills-access consent (AC4 intact, covered by `test/skills/builtin_skills_test.dart`).
- The missing half was the never-again hook: no release-gating check asserted SKILL.md CONTENT (byte size), only structure/wiring presence.

### Fix
- `scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` (new): the gh-1275 AC3 gate — flags empty/whitespace/frontmatter-only SKILL.md copies (1024-byte floor), skill dirs without SKILL.md, and packaged-vs-source name/byte drift; exit 1 with named `::error::` verdicts.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, `pages.yml`: fail-fast `Assert built-in skills packaged (gh-1275 AC3)` step in the iOS, Android (AAB + APK flavors), macOS, and web build jobs, before any build minute is spent (gh-798 "Assert TestFlight version floor" pattern).
- `test/skills/builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` (new): the same checkers run on every PR (gh-798 selftest pattern — the gate cannot rot silently), including RED fixtures shaped exactly like the incident (dirs present, content missing).
- `AGENTS.md`: retired the stale "js-apps seeds into `.fah/skills/` on startup" line (gh-1164 removed the seeder).

### Test Coverage
- `builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` — 13 tests: incident-shaped fixtures fail the gate (empty SKILL.md, dir without SKILL.md, stubs below the floor, parity drift), the real compiled `builtinSkillFiles` passes byte-identical to sources. PASS.
- `dart run scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` — exit 0 on the tree; exit 1 with named verdicts on a hollow fixture tree. VERIFIED.
- `test/skills/` + `test/prompts/` — 120 tests PASS. Full core suite: no regressions.

### Notes
- AC1/AC2 (verify TestFlight/Play/macOS/web builds end-to-end) still need a human release carrying this gate — the packaging path is shared pure-Dart compiled-in data, so the gate failing in any workflow proves the artifact is hollow before it ships.
- The cleanup in `_seedBundledSkills` intentionally leaves empty leftover dirs on upgraded devices; they are invisible to discovery (`_scanSkillDirs` skips dirs without SKILL.md) and harmless.

blocks.text:
name: 'Setup Flutter (persistent self-hosted SDK)'
description: >-
  Marker-pinned Flutter SDK kept under $HOME/actions-runner-yoloit across
  runs. On a persistent self-hosted runner the subosito/flutter-action
  cache is an anti-optimization (issue #354): setup untars a ~1GB archive
  every job and the POST step re-tars the whole SDK every run even when
  the version did not change — 14.5 of 19.7 minutes around a 4-minute
  iOS build. This action downloads the SDK exactly once per pinned
  version and reuses it subsecond afterwards. The SDK lives in
  per-version directories with an atomically-flipped `current` symlink
  (#357 review): both build-macos matrix arch legs run CONCURRENTLY on
  the one self-hosted runner, so every slot mutation is a single
  rename(2) and concurrent installs of the same pin converge instead of
  racing (sdk_slot.py documents the contract; test/
  setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart pins the decision scenarios and
  the regression guard).

inputs:
  flutter-version:
    description: 'Version spec — wildcard (3.47.x) or exact (3.47.4), same semantics as subosito/flutter-action'
    required: true

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Resolve pin and reuse-or-install the SDK
      id: sdk
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail

        SPEC='${{ inputs.flutter-version }}'
        SDK_ROOT="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/flutter-sdk"
        CURRENT="$SDK_ROOT/current"   # symlink -> $SDK_ROOT/<version>
        MARKER="$SDK_ROOT/.fah-version"
        SLOT="${{ github.action_path }}/sdk_slot.py"
        mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT"

        # Pre-#357 layouts kept the live SDK in a real `current`
        # directory — move it into its per-version slot once,
        # race-tolerantly (a concurrent leg that loses the migration
        # no-ops; os.rename never merges).
        python3 "$SLOT" migrate "$SDK_ROOT" "$MARKER"

        # Resolve the spec to a concrete stable version from the
        # official manifest (same resolution subosito/flutter-action
        # performs), then decide: SKIP (marker == wanted), REUSE
        # (manifest unreachable but the pinned SDK still satisfies the
        # spec) or INSTALL. The committed scenarios live in
        # test/setup_flutter_selfhosted_test.dart.
        DECISION="$(python3 "$SLOT" resolve "$SPEC" "$MARKER")"
        echo "$DECISION"
        VER="${DECISION#* }"
        DEST="$SDK_ROOT/$VER"

        # Self-heal before trusting a non-INSTALL verdict: a marker can
        # point at a version dir that a human or disk cleanup removed.
        # Without this the SKIP path would export a PATH entry with no
        # flutter binary under it and every later step would die at
        # `flutter --version` until someone deletes the marker by hand —
        # the brick the #357 review flagged on the old swap.
        if [[ "$DECISION" != INSTALL* && ! -d "$DEST" ]]; then
          echo "pinned $VER is missing from $SDK_ROOT — reinstalling"
          DECISION="INSTALL $VER"
        fi

        if [[ "$DECISION" == INSTALL* ]]; then
          if [[ -d "$DEST" ]]; then
            echo "Flutter $VER already installed by a concurrent leg — reusing it"
          else
            echo "Downloading Flutter $VER (spec: $SPEC) — one-time per pinned version..."
            STAGE="$(mktemp -d "$SDK_ROOT/.stage.XXXXXX")"
            # --max-time bounds EACH transfer, --retry-max-time bounds
            # the whole retry cycle: a wedged ~1GB download can never
            # hang the job until GitHub's ceiling kills it. (Same
            # pattern as the bounded asset downloads in build-macos.)
            if ! curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 5 \
                --max-time 600 --retry-max-time 900 \
                -o "$STAGE/flutter.zip" \
                "https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/macos/flutter_macos_${VER}-stable.zip"; then
              echo "::error::Flutter SDK download for $VER failed after retries (bounded: --max-time 600 per attempt, --retry-max-time 900 total). The runner's network or storage.googleapis.com is unhealthy — check and re-run; partial state stayed inside $STAGE only, the pinned slot is untouched."
              exit 1
            fi
            unzip -q "$STAGE/flutter.zip" -d "$STAGE"
            # Atomic slot-in: rename(2) either lands the complete tree
            # or refuses because a concurrent leg already installed the
            # identical version — the loser discards its duplicate
            # (both legs fetch the same archive, so the bytes match).
            python3 "$SLOT" install "$STAGE/flutter" "$DEST"
            rm -rf "$STAGE"
          fi
        elif [[ "$DECISION" == REUSE* ]]; then
          echo "::warning::Flutter manifest unreachable — reusing pinned SDK $VER (satisfies $SPEC)"
        else
          echo "Flutter $VER already pinned at $CURRENT — skipping the download (issue #354)"
        fi

        # Publish the slot with one atomic symlink swap — idempotent
        # under concurrency (both matrix legs flip to the same target).
        # Readers resolve `current` per use, so they observe either the
        # previous complete tree or this one, never a missing or
        # half-populated SDK; superseded trees are only gc'd after a
        # 2-day drain window, so in-flight legs keep a complete tree.
        python3 "$SLOT" flip "$DEST" "$CURRENT"
        echo "$VER" > "$MARKER"
        echo "Pinned Flutter $VER at $CURRENT -> $DEST"
        python3 "$SLOT" gc "$SDK_ROOT" "$DEST" 2

        # No actions/cache anywhere in this path: there is no POST step,
        # so no re-tar of the ~1GB SDK after every job.
        echo "$CURRENT/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
        echo "FLUTTER_ROOT=$CURRENT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        "$CURRENT/bin/flutter" --version

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1277
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1277
- **Title**: gh-1275 [BUG] Built-in skills (#1151) not packaged into the apps: iOS ships EMPTY skill dirs (create-goal/fa-self-config/js-apps exist, SKILL.md missing) — verify macOS/Android too
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1275` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +436
- **Deletions**: -2
- **Created**: 2026-10-05T10:11:19Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-05T11:51:12Z

## PR Description

## gh-1275 — Built-in skills must ship CONTENT, not just directory structure

### Root Cause
- 1.0.512's app-side skill delivery (#1151) seeded `.fah/skills/` from bundled Flutter assets; the packaging never packed the SKILL.md content (same asset-diet class as #1227/#1272), so apps shipped skill DIRECTORY STRUCTURE with no usable content and the agent had no built-in skills on iOS.
- The mechanism half is already fixed in tree (gh-1164): every `prompts/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` is compiled into pure-Dart `builtinSkillFiles` by `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` and served from `builtin://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` on every host — no asset-bundle/filesystem dependency, merged last into discovery, never gated by the skills-access consent (AC4 intact, covered by `test/skills/builtin_skills_test.dart`).
- The missing half was the never-again hook: no release-gating check asserted SKILL.md CONTENT (byte size), only structure/wiring presence.

### Fix
- `scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` (new): the gh-1275 AC3 gate — flags empty/whitespace/frontmatter-only SKILL.md copies (1024-byte floor), skill dirs without SKILL.md, and packaged-vs-source name/byte drift; exit 1 with named `::error::` verdicts.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, `pages.yml`: fail-fast `Assert built-in skills packaged (gh-1275 AC3)` step in the iOS, Android (AAB + APK flavors), macOS, and web build jobs, before any build minute is spent (gh-798 "Assert TestFlight version floor" pattern).
- `test/skills/builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` (new): the same checkers run on every PR (gh-798 selftest pattern — the gate cannot rot silently), including RED fixtures shaped exactly like the incident (dirs present, content missing).
- `AGENTS.md`: retired the stale "js-apps seeds into `.fah/skills/` on startup" line (gh-1164 removed the seeder).

### Test Coverage
- `builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` — 13 tests: incident-shaped fixtures fail the gate (empty SKILL.md, dir without SKILL.md, stubs below the floor, parity drift), the real compiled `builtinSkillFiles` passes byte-identical to sources. PASS.
- `dart run scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` — exit 0 on the tree; exit 1 with named verdicts on a hollow fixture tree. VERIFIED.
- `test/skills/` + `test/prompts/` — 120 tests PASS. Full core suite: no regressions.

### Notes
- AC1/AC2 (verify TestFlight/Play/macOS/web builds end-to-end) still need a human release carrying this gate — the packaging path is shared pure-Dart compiled-in data, so the gate failing in any workflow proves the artifact is hollow before it ships.
- The cleanup in `_seedBundledSkills` intentionally leaves empty leftover dirs on upgraded devices; they are invisible to discovery (`_scanSkillDirs` skips dirs without SKILL.md) and harmless.

# pr-1277: gh-1275 [BUG] Built-in skills (#1151) not packaged into the apps: iOS ships EMPTY skill dirs (create-goal/fa-self-config/js-apps exist, SKILL.md missing) — verify macOS/Android too

## Description

## gh-1275 — Built-in skills must ship CONTENT, not just directory structure

### Root Cause
- 1.0.512's app-side skill delivery (#1151) seeded `.fah/skills/` from bundled Flutter assets; the packaging never packed the SKILL.md content (same asset-diet class as #1227/#1272), so apps shipped skill DIRECTORY STRUCTURE with no usable content and the agent had no built-in skills on iOS.
- The mechanism half is already fixed in tree (gh-1164): every `prompts/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` is compiled into pure-Dart `builtinSkillFiles` by `scripts/gen_prompts.dart` and served from `builtin://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` on every host — no asset-bundle/filesystem dependency, merged last into discovery, never gated by the skills-access consent (AC4 intact, covered by `test/skills/builtin_skills_test.dart`).
- The missing half was the never-again hook: no release-gating check asserted SKILL.md CONTENT (byte size), only structure/wiring presence.

### Fix
- `scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` (new): the gh-1275 AC3 gate — flags empty/whitespace/frontmatter-only SKILL.md copies (1024-byte floor), skill dirs without SKILL.md, and packaged-vs-source name/byte drift; exit 1 with named `::error::` verdicts.
- `.github/workflows/build-mobile.yml`, `build-macos.yml`, `pages.yml`: fail-fast `Assert built-in skills packaged (gh-1275 AC3)` step in the iOS, Android (AAB + APK flavors), macOS, and web build jobs, before any build minute is spent (gh-798 "Assert TestFlight version floor" pattern).
- `test/skills/builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` (new): the same checkers run on every PR (gh-798 selftest pattern — the gate cannot rot silently), including RED fixtures shaped exactly like the incident (dirs present, content missing).
- `AGENTS.md`: retired the stale "js-apps seeds into `.fah/skills/` on startup" line (gh-1164 removed the seeder).

### Test Coverage
- `builtin_skill_packaging_guard_test.dart` — 13 tests: incident-shaped fixtures fail the gate (empty SKILL.md, dir without SKILL.md, stubs below the floor, parity drift), the real compiled `builtinSkillFiles` passes byte-identical to sources. PASS.
- `dart run scripts/verify_builtin_skills.dart` — exit 0 on the tree; exit 1 with named verdicts on a hollow fixture tree. VERIFIED.
- `test/skills/` + `test/prompts/` — 120 tests PASS. Full core suite: no regressions.

### Notes
- AC1/AC2 (verify TestFlight/Play/macOS/web builds end-to-end) still need a human release carrying this gate — the packaging path is shared pure-Dart compiled-in data, so the gate failing in any workflow proves the artifact is hollow before it ship…
